cards.text: Jesus just raised a widow's only son back to life in a town called Nain, and the news spread through Judea and all the surrounding region (Luke 7:11-17). Now it reaches John the Baptist, the prophet who preached a baptism of repentance around the Jordan (Luke 3:3). John's disciples tell him about all these things.

cards.question: John calls two of his disciples and sends them to Jesus with a question. What does John want to know?

answers.text: If Jesus is the One who was to come
If Jesus will come and baptize with him
If Jesus will teach them how to pray

cards.text: The two men find Jesus and repeat John's question exactly: "Are You the One who was to come, or should we look for someone else?" Friend, I've seen a message go through three coworkers and come out a WHOLE different message, but not with these two.

cards.question: True or false: At that very hour, Jesus heals many people of their diseases.
Jesus doesn't give John's men a plain yes or no. What does He tell them to report back to John?

answers.text: What they have seen and heard
That John should come and see
That they must wait for a sign

cards.text: Then Jesus spells it out: the blind receive sight, the lame walk, lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear and the dead are raised. Those two men walked in with ONE question, and now they're walking out with a whole report to carry.

cards.question: There's one more thing on Jesus' list. The good news is preached to the ___.
John asked if Jesus is the One who was to come. Jesus ends His reply to John with a blessing. Who does Jesus say is blessed?

answers.text: The one who does not fall away because of Him
The one who has seen His miracles up close
The one who keeps every word of the law

cards.text: After John's messengers leave, Jesus starts talking to the crowds about John and asks, "What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed swaying in the wind?" Friend, nobody makes a trip that far out of town unless there's something worth SEEING.

cards.question: Next Jesus asks if the crowds went out to see a man in fine clothes. True or false: Jesus says people who wear elegant clothing and live in luxury are found in the wilderness.

cards.text: Third guess, and Jesus asks it straight: "What then did you go out to see? A prophet?" Then He answers His own question.

cards.question: Jesus asks the crowds if they went out to see a prophet. What is His answer about John?

answers.text: Yes and more than a prophet
No he is only a teacher
Not yet but someday he will be

cards.text: Jesus says Scripture already wrote about John. It speaks of a messenger sent on ahead.

cards.question: In the Scripture Jesus quotes about John, the messenger is sent ahead to ___ the way.

cards.text: Then Jesus says that among those born of women, there is NO ONE greater than John. Friend, if anybody said that about me, I'd stamp it on every cookie in the bakery, but Jesus isn't done.

cards.question: True or false: Jesus says even the least in the kingdom of God is still not as great as John.

cards.text: All the people who hear this acknowledge God's justice, even the tax collectors. Friend, I spent years in a junk drawer with dead batteries that couldn't agree on ANYTHING, and here's a whole crowd on the same page.

cards.question: The people who hear Jesus, even the tax collectors, acknowledge God's justice. What reason does the passage give?

answers.text: They had paid back what they owed
They had given money to the poor

cards.question: But the Pharisees, a strict group of Jewish religious leaders, and the experts in the law had not been baptized by John. They reject God's ___ for themselves.

cards.text: Jesus is still talking to the crowds, and now He asks, "To what, then, can I compare the men of this generation? What are they like?" He's about to answer with a picture.

Jesus says they're like children sitting in the marketplace, calling out to one another about the flute they played and the dirge they sang. Happy song, sad song, these children came with the WHOLE playlist.

cards.question: In Jesus' picture, the children played the flute and sang a dirge for the others. What do they complain about?

answers.text: The others did not dance or weep
The others took their flute away

cards.question: Jesus explains the picture. John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine. How does Jesus say people respond to John?

answers.text: They bring him bread and wine

cards.text: Jesus says what people say about John: "He has a demon!" Then the Son of Man, the name Jesus uses for Himself (Mark 2:10), comes eating and drinking.

cards.question: True or false: Jesus says that when the Son of Man comes eating and drinking, people finally approve of Him.

cards.text: Jesus says the word on Him is, "Look at this glutton and drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!" Friend, that's the coworker who complains the office is too cold on Monday and too HOT on Tuesday.

cards.question: Jesus closes the comparison with one line, and it starts with "But." Wisdom is proven ___ by all her children.
